{{Quote|We know now that the Chirq Council is governed by nine members who call themselves the Elite Council. Your next task is simple enough, though quite dangerous: Eliminate the Elite Council.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize|Baize]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Elite Council''' was the ruling body of the [[Chirq Council]], a criminal organization active on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Magnificently done! Reports are already coming in that say the Chirq Council is splintering. Without the discipline and motivation provided by the Elite Council, they are turning on one another and falling to pieces.|Captain Baize, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Elite Council was made of nine members, namely [[Markus Gilder]], [[Zuld Mar-Shayal]], [[Braganti Hooge]], [[Koran Lassk]], [[Janos Zarbo]], [[Mathazar Zayet]], [[Rallyn Secura]], [[Crale Forte]] and [[Atlan Dubreas]]. They were based in two bunkers, the [[First Elite Council Bunker|First]] and the [[Second Elite Council Bunker]]s, located near the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]].<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the Chirq Council following the increase of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] traffic on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] successfully infiltrated a CorSec agent within the organization. Assuming the identity of the Chirq Council member [[Trins Evnar]], the CorSec agent managed to infiltrate [[Jzoro Quanera]]'s Chirq Council chapter in Doaba Guerfel. From Jzoro Quanera's database, the CorSec obtained the identity of the nine elite councilors and the locations of their secret headquarters.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Moving Up|Corellia}}</ref> The Corsec finally assaulted the First and Second Elite Council Bunkers and eliminated all the nine elite councilors. After the death of the elite councilors, the Chirq Council splintered.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Elite Council of the Chirq Council appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Elite Council was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
